value.question: What is the AI Mentorship Programme?
value.answer: A structured 1-on-1 mentorship service with Mahmood Salah, a Senior Data Scientist and AI Engineer. Depending on your plan, you get direct chat support, live video sessions, code reviews, architecture guidance, and a clear roadmap to reach your AI goals — whether you are learning, building a project, or scaling AI within your company.

value.question: Who is this mentorship for?
value.answer: There are three audiences: (1) Learners taking AI or data science courses who want expert support to move faster and understand deeply. (2) Aspiring AI engineers who want hands-on guidance to build, ship, and showcase a real AI project. (3) Startups, teams, and companies that need expert direction to evaluate, design, and implement AI solutions in their business.

value.question: Do I need prior programming experience?
value.answer: For the AI Learning Support plan, basic familiarity with Python is helpful but not required. We will start from where you are and build from there. For the AI Project Mentorship, you should be comfortable writing code. For the AI Consulting for Teams plan, no technical background is required from you — we handle the technical depth.

value.question: What does each plan include?
value.answer: AI Learning Support (5/month): Unlimited chat support, 2 hours of 1:1 video mentoring, concept explanations, and a personalised study plan. — AI Project Mentorship (50 for 2 months): Unlimited chat, 10 hours of 1:1 video, architecture review, code review, model optimisation guidance, and deployment strategy. — AI Consulting for Teams (,200 for 3–4 months): AI use-case assessment, technical architecture planning, team training, and full implementation and deployment support.

value.question: How is this different from an online course?
value.answer: A course gives you content. This gives you a thinking partner. You get real-time feedback on your specific situation, decisions, and code — not generic lectures. The sessions are designed around your goals, your blockers, and your timeline. Everything is adapted to you.

value.question: What outcomes can I expect?
value.answer: AI Learning Support: Faster learning, fewer sticking points, and a structured path through your course or subject. AI Project Mentorship: A complete, deployable AI project ready for your portfolio or production. AI Consulting for Teams: A clear AI implementation roadmap and a working system integrated into your business processes.

value.question: How much time do I need to commit each week?
value.answer: It depends on your plan and pace. For AI Learning Support, even 3–5 hours per week is enough to make real progress. For AI Project Mentorship, plan for around 8–10 hours per week to move quickly over 2 months. For AI Consulting for Teams, your involvement is flexible — we work around your schedule.

value.question: Is pricing really limited time?
value.answer: Yes. These are early-access rates offered while I scale the programme. The prices will increase once each cohort is full. Booking now locks in the current rate for your full engagement period.

value.question: How do I get started?
value.answer: Click the Get Started button on your chosen plan. You will be taken to a short booking form or calendar link to schedule an introductory call. We will then align on your goals, confirm the plan details, and kick off your mentorship.

value: Everything you need to know about BootcampAI's programmes, scholarships, and applications.

value.question: What is BootcampAI?
value.answer: BootcampAI is the first non-profit AI education platform in the Middle East. We run intensive, project-based bootcamps that take learners from foundational concepts to building, deploying, and shipping real AI systems — covering Large Language Models, Computer Vision, and Deep Learning.

value.question: Who can apply to a BootcampAI programme?
value.answer: Anyone serious about becoming an AI engineer can apply. We welcome computer science students, software engineers, data analysts, recent graduates, and self-taught developers. A short technical challenge during the application process helps us match learners to the right programme and scholarship tier.

value.question: Are the bootcamps really free or subsidised?
value.answer: Yes. Because BootcampAI is non-profit, every seat is subsidised. The LLM & Agentic AI Bootcamp offers 30 fully funded scholarships (100% coverage) and 30 partially funded seats at 80% off — bringing the cost down to only ~30 USD versus the ~,200 market value. Future programmes will follow a similar model.

value.question: Do I need prior AI or programming experience?
value.answer: You should be comfortable with Python and have basic familiarity with linear algebra and probability. You do not need prior machine learning experience — we build everything from first principles. The technical challenge in the application is designed to verify readiness, not gatekeep.

value.question: What language is the instruction in?
value.answer: Instruction is delivered in English with Arabic-language support available throughout the programme via mentors and the 24/7 AI assistant. All written materials, code, and project assignments are in English to match industry practice.

value.question: How much time do I need to commit per week?
value.answer: Plan for around 15–20 hours per week across live sessions, project work, code reviews, and self-study. The 10-week format is intentionally intensive — graduates leave with a portfolio, not just a certificate.

value.question: What do I get when I graduate?
value.answer: A verified BootcampAI certificate, a portfolio of weekly projects you can publish on GitHub and LinkedIn, a capstone project ready to demo to employers, six months of post-graduation mentorship, and access to our hiring network of partner companies.

value.question: When will the Computer Vision and Deep Learning bootcamps launch?
value.answer: Both programmes are in active development and will launch in the coming cohorts. Join the waitlist on either programme card above to receive launch dates, early-bird pricing, and priority admission as soon as applications open.

value.question: Can companies sponsor employees or run a private cohort?
value.answer: Yes. The For Companies / Enterprise Programs section below explains how we partner with organisations to upskill teams, design private custom curricula, and integrate AI into your business. Get in touch by email to discuss.

value.question: How is BootcampAI different from an online course?
value.answer: A course gives you content. BootcampAI gives you a structured 10-week journey with live mentorship, weekly project deliverables, code reviews, accountability, and a graduating cohort. You do not finish with notes — you finish with shipped projects and the engineering judgement to build more.

value: If your question isn't here, ask us. We'll walk you through what an AI Employee would do for your team.

value.question: What is an AI Employee?
value.answer: An AI Employee is an AI agent set up for a specific role in your company. It works inside your existing tools, like email, chat, calendars, project boards, your CRM and code, and delivers finished work: documents, replies, updated records and reports, not just suggestions.

value.question: Will it replace people on my team?
value.answer: No. It's designed to add capacity, not to remove people. It takes on repetitive tasks so your team can spend more time on work that needs human judgement, and important actions wait for a person's approval.

value.question: Does it learn about our company?
value.answer: Yes. As it works, it builds up context about your projects, clients, documents and the way your team does things, so each task starts from what it already knows. It only uses information from the tools and data you've given it access to.

value.question: Which tools does it work with?
value.answer: Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Google Calendar, Jira, Linear, Monday.com, Notion, HubSpot, GitHub, shared files and more than 40 tools in total. If you rely on something else, we'll confirm during discovery whether we can connect it.

value.question: How do you keep it safe?
value.answer: It only gets the access you grant. By default, anything consequential, such as sending messages, changing calendars or updating records, waits for approval. Every task keeps a full activity log, and you can pause it or revoke access at any time.

value.question: Where does our data go?
value.answer: That depends on the plan. On your computers, data stays on each device apart from what is sent to the AI model. Hosted by Automati, it runs on infrastructure we manage. On your servers, everything stays inside your own network, including the AI model if you choose a private one.

value.question: Which AI model does it use?
value.answer: You choose. It works with leading models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, or with open models running privately on your own servers.

value.question: How long does setup take?
value.answer: Most teams have their first AI Employee working within one to two weeks, depending on how many tools and processes are involved. Larger rollouts are planned together with you.

value.question: How is pricing calculated?
value.answer: You pay per AI Employee per month, based on where it runs, plus a one-time setup fee from $499 per company that covers discovery, configuration and training for your team.

value.question: Can we start small?
value.answer: Yes. Most companies start with one AI Employee for one team, see the time it saves, and then add more roles.
